cases.question: What year was Farmingdale State College founded?

runs.answer: Farmingdale State College was founded in 1912. It started as the New York State School of Agriculture on Long Island, and its first students arrived in 1916. The college's archives say it is the oldest public institution of higher education on Long Island ([College Archives: Country Life Program](https://www.farmingdale.edu/library/college-archives/countrylife/index.shtml)). For more on the school's early history and name changes, see the [College Archives timeline](https://www.farmingdale.edu/library/college-archives/history-name.shtml).

You can see the details on the [Residence Halls page](https://www.farmingdale.edu/residence-life/residencehalls.shtml). Residence Life can be reached at reslife@farmingdale.edu or 934-420-2010, and the housing application is in your MyFSC Portal.

Yes, FSC has on-campus housing. The college has three residence halls: **Alumni Hall, Dewey Hall, and Orchard Hall**.

a.question: As a woman, can I live on campus at FSC?
a.answer:
Yes. Any registered FSC student can live on campus, though priority will be given to full-time matriculated students. The college's standard is same-sex housing assignments within the rooms of all campus housing, and its handbook describes a gender-inclusive housing policy for students who need a different arrangement. You can read more in the [Residence Life Handbook 2025/2026](https://www.farmingdale.edu/residence-life/residence-life-res-hall-guide-2025-2026.pdf).

To apply, you'll need to give written notice to Residence Life 30 days before the semester if you later cancel. You can start with the [Housing Application](https://admissions.farmingdale.edu/register/res_life_2022). For questions about a specific room, contact Residence Life directly.

b.question: As a man, can I live on campus at FSC?
b.answer:
Yes, your gender doesn't decide whether you can live on campus. Any registered FSC student can live on campus, though priority will be given to full-time matriculated students. Only full-time, matriculated students who are already registered for fall classes in good standing with the college are eligible to participate in room selection. Good standing includes financial, academic, and disciplinary standings.

Room assignments follow a standard rule: the College provides students with same-sex housing assignments within the rooms of all campus housing. The college also offers gender-inclusive housing, and students who wish to request a gender-inclusive living space may do so by indicating the request on their housing application or by emailing reslife@farmingdale.edu.

For the full details, see the [Residence Life Handbook 2025/2026](https://www.farmingdale.edu/residence-life/residence-life-res-hall-guide-2025-2026.pdf). Residence Life is the office to contact with questions.
